title: The Lowest Level
text: Stairs go down past where any map shows, past the deepest mark any miner ever cut. The air grows warm, then soft, and smells of rain on summer earth. Far below, impossibly, a bird is singing.

options.label: Go down toward the singing, deeper than anyone has gone before.

outcomes.text: A garden underground, impossible and real, and the warm air knits you as you breathe it.
A garden underground, and something tending it that does not like guests.

options.label: The keenest ear listens at the top of the stairs, before anyone descends.

outcomes.text: Rain, and singing, and then nothing at all. But they heard enough to know what lies ahead.

options.label: Climb back up while you still want to. Some places are not meant for you.

outcomes.text: Some places are not for you. The smell of warm rain stays in the Leader's clothes; it is a comfort, and it should not be.
